map.≥50 建议立即处理，35~50 为中等需加强管理，<25 为低风险；评分仅作预: ≥50 calls for immediate action, 35-50 is medium and needs tighter management, and <25 is low risk; the score is only a warning, and abnormal mortality must be confirmed with microscopy.
